description_en: Queries origin bandwidth data for accelerated domain names
description_zh: 调用DescribeDomainRealTimeSrcBpsData查询域名回源带宽数据
name: DescribeDomainRealTimeSrcBpsData

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name. You can specify up to 100 domain names in each request. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 加速域名，多个域名用半角逗号（,）分隔，一次最多支持100个域名查询
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据起始时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的结束时间点。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

DataInterval.description_en:
The time interval between the data entries returned. Unit: seconds.

The time granularity varies with the maximum time range per query. Valid values: 60 (1 minute), 300 (5 minutes), and 3600(1 hour). For more information, see Usage notes
DataInterval.description_zh:
每条记录的时间间隔，单位：秒。

根据单次查询的最大时间跨度不同，该参数固定返回60（1分钟）、300（5分钟）或3600（1小时），具体请参见使用说明中返回数据时间粒度

EndTime.description_en: The end of the time range during which data was queried

StartTime.description_en: The start of the time range during which data was queried
